title: Kit and dependency contracts before implementation
summary: The decision defines pure kit descriptors, separate declaration/Worker/Node entries, canonical provenance, one dependency graph, source integrity and one-blank Promise/Effect dependency wrappers. Independent review caught and closed a client import leak by separating pure dependency declarations from runtime implementations.
proves: A decision record is written. Independent read-only review passed the dependency split at 66e28fb7 and the explicit pure-descriptor clarification at 3e666e9a. Captures verify the reviewed record identities. This establishes the design contract, not L3.01 implementation, new runtime checks, Node 24/Linux spike portability or Gate 3.

captions.01-recorded-contract: The dependency-split decision matched reviewed commit 66e28fb7 when captured.
captions.02-pure-descriptor-contract: The current record matches independently reviewed clarification 3e666e9a; no implementation claim.
